metadata.methods_description: 64-channel EEG recordings were acquired during a reading task in which participants evaluated 210 texts (70 Haiku, 70 Senryu, 70 control texts) across five subjective dimensions using a 7-point scale. Resting-state EEG was recorded at the beginning and end of each session. Participants completed trait-level questionnaires including PANAS, Openness, Curiosity, VVIQ, AVIQ, MAAS, and AReA. Data collection occurred at the Department of Psychology, Goldsmiths University of London, UK, and was approved by the Local Ethics Committee. This dataset (Dataset 1) includes 47 participants whose continuous EEG recordings passed technical validation and were used in primary analyses. A companion dataset (Dataset 2) contains data from 4 additional participants whose EEG recordings were acquired in segments and later concatenated during preprocessing.
